semantics: Distinct harness-internal specifiers (a tsconfig alias that names packages/harness/src, such as @agent, @common, @controllers, @logger, @model, @platform, @shared, @skills, @tools, @transcript and @utils) that each app, host and viewer package imports from its src (packages/texra, packages/cli, packages/desktop, packages/extension, packages/trace-viewer), per the split design §4 and ruling SQ2: they should reach the harness only through @texra-ai/harness and its subpaths. Set-based and shrink-only: a live specifier absent from a package's list is a new deep import and fails; a listed specifier with no live import is stale headroom and also fails (remove it here). The split design counted 254 distinct specifiers when SQ2 was ruled; at cb311a7a05 (M8's end) the count was 256 distinct and 501 per-package rows for the four app and host packages. Remove a deep import by giving the symbol a documented public export with a consumer, or by moving the module to the package that owns it.
